item.title: Christmas Week Trash Routes for West Plains
item.description: The City of West Plains has announced trash pick up routes for the week of Christmas. Monday and Tuesday routes will be picked up on Monday. Wednesday and Thursday routes will be collected on Tuesday, and Friday routes will be collected on Wednesday. They wish everyone a Merry Christmas.
